about_bitbones: bitbones ni umukiriya wa gui w'abategura porogaramu kuri bitsocial, werekana amakuru ya porotokole ari inyuma ya buri paji
about_bitsocial: Bitsocial ni urusobe rwa peer-to-peer rufunguye rugenewe porogaramu mbonezamubano, rutagira seriveri, rutagira kwirukanwa rusange ku isi hose, aho abakoresha n'imiryango ari umutungo ugenzurwa n'urufunguzo rwa kiriputogarafiya.
